CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_EMPLOYER_CRM] AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_Employer AS (
	SELECT
		--CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',BCD.EMPLOYERID),1) AS EmployerId
		CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',BCM.STRTEXT4),1)  AS EmployerId
		,BCM.STRTEXT4 AS EmployerName
		,NULL AS LocationId
		,BCM.STRTEXT7 AS EmployerTelephoneNumber
		,BCM.STRTEXT8 AS EmployerFaxNumber
		,NULL AS EmployerEmailAddress
		,NULL AS EmployerUsFederalEmployerId
		,NULL AS PartyId
		,NULL AS DunsNumber
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetHeadquarters
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetBranch
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetDivision
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetSubsidiary
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetParent
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetUltimate
		,NULL AS DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate
		,BCM.STRTEXT3 AS AnzsicClassCode
		,BCM.STRTEXT17 AS SectorCode
		,BCM.STRTEXT25 AS SicIndustryCode
		,BCD.USERFIELD8 AS SmeClassCode
		,BCM.STRTEXT23 AS Subsector
		,BCM.STRTEXT5 AS EmployerAddress1
		,BCM.STRTEXT6 AS EmployerAddress2
		,BCM.STRTEXT28 AS EmployerAddress3
		,NULL AS EmployerAddress4
		,BCM.STRTEXT18 AS CityId
		,BCM.STRTEXT20 AS StateId
		,BCM.STRTEXT19 AS ZipCode
		,BCM.STRTEXT21 AS Country
		,BCM.STRTEXT1 AS EmployerCodeOccupationLegal
		,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
		,BCM.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,BCM.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCMD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO_DELTA BCMD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO BCM ON BCMD.MISCELLANEOUSID = BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID AND BCMD.BANK_ID = BCM.BANK_ID AND BCMD.isLatest = 1 AND BCM.TYPE = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT'
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC BCD  ON BCD.ORGKEY = BCM.ORGKEY  AND BCM.isLatest = 1
	WHERE BCM.ORGKEY IS NOT NULL and  BCM.MISCELLANEOUSID IS NOT NULL and ISNULL(BCM.STRTEXT4,'') <> ''
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Employer FROM TEMP_BNKM_Employer;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH TEMP_BNKM_Employer_SRC AS (
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
									EmployerId
									,EmployerName
									,EmployerTelephoneNumber
									,EmployerFaxNumber
									,AnzsicClassCode
									,SectorCode
									,SicIndustryCode
									,SmeClassCode
									,Subsector
									,EmployerAddress1
									,EmployerAddress2
									,EmployerAddress3
									,CityId
									,StateId
									,ZipCode
									,Country
									,EmployerCodeOccupationLegal)
									) AS HASHROW
		,EmployerId
		,financialinstitutionid
		,SourceSystemCode
		,RECORD_STATUS 
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Employer WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_Employer_TGT AS (
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
									EmployerId
									,EmployerName
									,EmployerTelephoneNumber
									,EmployerFaxNumber
									,AnzsicClassCode
									,SectorCode
									,SicIndustryCode
									,SmeClassCode
									,Subsector
									,EmployerAddress1
									,EmployerAddress2
									,EmployerAddress3
									,CityId
									,StateId
									,ZipCode
									,Country
									,EmployerCodeOccupationLegal)
									) AS HASHROW
		,EmployerId
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,SourceSystemCode
	FROM BNKM.Employer 
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
)


,
TEMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.EmployerId,TGT.EmployerId) AS EmployerId
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId	
		,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode				
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_Employer_SRC	SRC
	FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_Employer_TGT	TGT
	ON	SRC.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId
	AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
	AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
[EmployerId]  = SRC.EmployerId
,[EmployerName] = SRC.EmployerName
,[LocationId] = SRC.LocationId
,[EmployerTelephoneNumber] = SRC.EmployerTelephoneNumber
,[EmployerFaxNumber] = SRC.EmployerFaxNumber
,[EmployerEmailAddress] = NULL
,[EmployerUsFederalEmployerId] = NULL
,[PartyId] = NULL
,[DunsNumber] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetBranch] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetDivision] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetParent] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetUltimate] = NULL
,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate] = NULL
,[AnzsicClassCode] = SRC.AnzsicClassCode
,[SectorCode] = SRC.SectorCode
,[SicIndustryCode] = SRC.SicIndustryCode
,[SmeClassCode] = SRC.SmeClassCode
,[Subsector] = SRC.Subsector
,[EmployerAddress1] = SRC.EmployerAddress1
,[EmployerAddress2] = SRC.EmployerAddress2
,[EmployerAddress3] = SRC.EmployerAddress3
,[EmployerAddress4] = NULL
,[CityId] = SRC.CityId
,[StateId] = SRC.StateId
,[ZipCode] = SRC.ZipCode
,[Country] = SRC.Country
,[EmployerCodeOccupationLegal] = SRC.EmployerCodeOccupationLegal
,[SourceSystemCode] = 'CRM'
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Employer TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Employer SRC ON SRC.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId  AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM';

---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.Employer (
	[EmployerId]
	,[EmployerName]
	,[LocationId]
	,[EmployerTelephoneNumber]
	,[EmployerFaxNumber]
	,[EmployerEmailAddress]
	,[EmployerUsFederalEmployerId]
	,[PartyId]
	,[DunsNumber]
	,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters]
	,[DunBradstreetBranch]
	,[DunBradstreetDivision]
	,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetParent]
	,[DunBradstreetUltimate]
	,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate]
	,[AnzsicClassCode]
	,[SectorCode]
	,[SicIndustryCode]
	,[SmeClassCode]
	,[Subsector]
	,[EmployerAddress1]
	,[EmployerAddress2]
	,[EmployerAddress3]
	,[EmployerAddress4]
	,[CityId]
	,[StateId]
	,[ZipCode]
	,[Country]
	,[EmployerCodeOccupationLegal]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT
	[EmployerId]
	,[EmployerName]
	,[LocationId]
	,[EmployerTelephoneNumber]
	,[EmployerFaxNumber]
	,[EmployerEmailAddress]
	,[EmployerUsFederalEmployerId]
	,[PartyId]
	,[DunsNumber]
	,[DunBradstreetSingleLocationSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetHeadquarters]
	,[DunBradstreetBranch]
	,[DunBradstreetDivision]
	,[DunBradstreetSubsidiary]
	,[DunBradstreetParent]
	,[DunBradstreetUltimate]
	,[DunBradstreetGlobalUltimate]
	,[AnzsicClassCode]
	,[SectorCode]
	,[SicIndustryCode]
	,[SmeClassCode]
	,[Subsector]
	,[EmployerAddress1]
	,[EmployerAddress2]
	,[EmployerAddress3]
	,[EmployerAddress4]
	,[CityId]
	,[StateId]
	,[ZipCode]
	,[Country]
	,[EmployerCodeOccupationLegal]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Employer
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Employer;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Employer_DELTA;

END
